description: Control of round 7e (names of Object.prototype): head adds `@pytest.mark.constructor` — a custom mark, which pytest applies and runs (an unknown-mark warning, not a skip) — `pytest.toString()` inside `try/except AttributeError`, and locals named `constructor` and `valueOf`. A name read from the analysed code is looked up only among a table's own keys, never its prototype: no marker, no finding, no exception. The real runner runs the test.
